lines: Veyra runs on one machine: the Core, deep under the Vault.
The Vault keeps its parts, its power and its records.
VIGIL, the security system, keeps the Vault.
Three weeks ago the Core began to fail.
A magenta corruption, the Bleed, spread through the machines.
Ops sends Runners down, one unit at a time.
Your job: reach the Core and shut it down.
The Core goes dark. The Bleed has nothing left to feed on.
Its first act is to open every door in the Vault.
Up in Veyra, the lights flicker once, then hold steady.
